hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each character in the alphabet has a symmetric partner across the alphabet boundary.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Character c at offset i from the start pairs with the character at offset 25 - i.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Tally frequencies of all characters and sum absolute differences between symmetric partner counts divided by two.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

def mirrorFrequencyDistance(s: str) -> int:
    counts = Counter(s)
    total_diff = 0
    for i in range(26):
        c1 = chr(ord('a') + i)
        c2 = chr(ord('z') - i)
        total_diff += abs(counts[c1] - counts[c2])
    return total_diff // 2
```

complexity.notes: Counts string characters in linear time and checks 26 alphabet pairs in constant time.

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates with fixed alphabet size 26 in O(1) auxiliary space.
